annotation.summary_en: A stressed football coach gives a cynical pep talk and a sponsored tactical briefing to his nervous team before a big match, only to be surprised by a birthday celebration.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a sports locker room where a group of football players in jerseys and a goalkeeper are nervously awaiting their coach. The coach, wearing a suit, enters and immediately begins berating the team for their cowardice, mocking those who are hiding in the bathroom out of fear. One player asks for a cigarette to calm his nerves, prompting the coach to lament his life choices, regretting that he didn't go to medical school as his father wished instead of becoming a 'hambal' (laborer) in sports. He attempts to deliver a tactical briefing using a whiteboard, but hilariously treats the tactic diagram as a sponsored TV segment, announcing a real estate developer as the sponsor for the scheme. He describes the opponent's 4-3-3 formation and proposes a desperate 9+1 defensive strategy. The lights suddenly go out, and the coach begins to scold the players further, only for the team to break into a rendition of 'Happy Birthday.' Touched, the coach asks for a victory as his gift, but the players reveal they have already bought him a shirt instead, and they all pose for a photo with their trophies.
catchphrases: Չէ, ես ընդունվա ֆիզկուլտ, դառա համբալ։
